Title: DocLayout Component
Summary: Two-column documentation layout with sticky sidebar navigation and content area.
Content:
## DocLayoutComponent

**Selector:** `app-doc-layout`

**Imports:** `RouterOutlet`, `RouterLink`, `RouterLinkActive`

### State (Signals)
- `sidebarOpen: WritableSignal<boolean>` — Controls sidebar visibility (default `true`)
- `docPages: Signal<DocPage[]>` — Sidebar navigation items

### Methods
- `toggleSidebar(): void` — Toggles sidebar on mobile

### Sidebar Pages
| ID | Title | Route | Icon |
|----|-------|-------|------|
| getting-started | Getting Started | `/docs/getting-started` | `bi-rocket` |
| concepts | Core Concepts | `/docs/concepts` | `bi-lightbulb` |
| api | API Reference | `/docs/api` | `bi-code-square` |
| guides | Guides | `/docs/guides` | `bi-book` |
| faq | FAQ | `/docs/faq` | `bi-question-circle` |

### Layout
- Sidebar: 260px width, sticky at top below navbar, scrollable
- Content: Flexible width with container padding
- Mobile: Sidebar collapsible via toggle button
